in_hebrew.name: Lemuel
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dedicated to God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lemuel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, the name Lemuel means 'dedicated to God'. This name is mentioned only once in the Bible, in the book of Job, where it is used to describe Job's eldest son.

in_latin.name: Lemuel
in_latin.meaning: Nomen biblicum, significat virum fortiter loquentem, virum virtutem habentem
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lemuel est originis hebraicae, significat virum fortiter loquentem, virum virtutem habentem. In Veteri Testamento Lemuel est rex, qui habebat filiam nomine Salomonis. Lemuel significat virtutem et fortitudo. In Ecclesiastico 31:3 Lemuel dicitur vir virtutem habens, qui habet virtutem et fortitudo. In Ecclesiastico 31:4 Lemuel dicitur vir fortiter loquentem, qui loquitur fortiter et habet virtutem.
